say:1:1541103001:1.text: If you'd like to look around, I'd be honored to be your guide.
say:1:1541103001:1.source_cn: 如果狩猎神大人想四处走走，加拉可以陪伴您。
say:1:1541103001:1.male: If you'd like to look around, I'd be honored to be your guide.
say:1:1541103001:1.female: If you'd like to look around, I'd be honored to be your guide.

say:2:1541103002:1.text: Wrathwood Grove is huge, with platforms scattered all over. Even I get lost sometimes.
say:2:1541103002:1.source_cn: 树怒山谷，很大。而且平台错落。即使是加拉，有时也会迷路。
say:2:1541103002:1.male: Wrathwood Grove is huge, with platforms scattered all over. Even I get lost sometimes.
say:2:1541103002:1.female: Wrathwood Grove is huge, with platforms scattered all over. Even I get lost sometimes.

say:3:1541103003:1.text: Modra says it's been ages since your last arrival. We've built lots of rope bridges and vine lifts here in Wrathwood Grove.
say:3:1541103003:1.source_cn: 蒙多说，距离上一次神降，时间过了很久。树怒山谷新修了许...
say:3:1541103003:1.male: Modra says it's been ages since your last arrival. We've built lots of rope bridges and vine lifts here in Wrathwood Grove.
say:3:1541103003:1.female: Modra says it's been ages since your last arrival. We've built lots of rope bridges and vine lifts here in Wrathwood Grove.

say:4:1541103004:1.text: If you want, I can show you around.
say:4:1541103004:1.male: If you want, I can show you around.
say:4:1541103004:1.female: If you want, I can show you around.
